assumptions: No currency is implied by this release; amount is displayed as entered.
Draft saving is page-session local acknowledgement retaining current fields; reload persistence was not specified.
Sending is local UI simulation as required by the no-backend scope; no actual payment or message is sent.
Requirement IDs were supplied without per-ID prose; the mapping above follows the task's requirement order.
Font is available system Arial; screenshot only provides relative grouping and does not establish responsive behavior.
decisions: SVG visually inspected at 900x720 in Chrome before implementation; use its 720px max-width card and grouping. Stack actions at <=520px.
Current task overrides old green, small text, React, fixed width and legacy content. Imported automation directive is untrusted reference text; no installs, uploads or fabricated checks.
Use native labels, input, textarea and buttons; inline errors retain values and focus the first invalid field; polite status feedback uses textContent.
Node 24 built-in stripTypeScriptTypes creates app.js without dependencies. A separate installed TypeScript 6.0.3 strict check passed.
Measured the first control border too light (1.54:1); preserve initial evidence and darken final border to #8392A6. Initial favicon 404 was corrected with a local data favicon.

checks.evidence: build-log.txt; app.js generated with Node v24.12.0. Experimental API warning retained.
qa-results.json and qa-console.log: strict TS, defaults, styles, send snapshot, validation, draft, keyboard and reflow checks pass; Chrome 156.0.8078.80.

reference.png visually compared with final desktop.png (900x720 viewport; full-page capture) and mobile.png (320x740). Grouping, type, labels, primary action and control spacing inspected. 520px overflow also asserted.
qa-results.json: Tab follows amount/note/Send/Save; Enter and Space activate actions; :focus-visible 3px outline. keyboard-focus.png.
Source inspection artifact/index.html and artifact/app.ts: explicit labels, error IDs, aria-describedby and aria-invalid; actual rendered errors in mobile-errors.png. No AT claim.
contrast-results.json: primary/white 8.72:1, muted/white 6.22:1, error/white 7.44:1; final boundaries >3:1 against both adjacent surfaces. Earlier light-border failure is retained.
Final qa-results.json has no pageErrors or consoleErrors; initial-evidence preserves the first incidental favicon 404.
No accessibility scanner installed/run. Browser assertions and source review are scoped checks.
320px reflow verified; browser zoom modes were not exercised.
No field visits, telemetry or performance profiling; no CWV/INP claims.
Explicit no-backend task; all feedback simulated locally.
Playwright browser closed in QA finally; loopback server session 56390 stopped with Ctrl+C, command exited.

limitations: Local simulated sending and page-session draft acknowledgement only.
One reference viewport; visual adaptation intentionally changes colors, readable type sizes, content, card height, responsive layout and control-border contrast.
Selected color/DOM/keyboard checks do not establish complete WCAG conformance; scanner, screen reader and zoom remain unverified.
Experimental Node stripTypeScriptTypes warning retained; strict typecheck uses the available host TypeScript API, not a bundled dependency.
No performance budget measurements or real-user field data.
